UPDATE email_reconciliation_provider_backfill
            SET
                available_at = clock_timestamp() + make_interval(secs => $2),
                lease_id = NULL,
                lease_until = NULL,
                updated_at = clock_timestamp()
            WHERE name = 'v1'
                AND lease_id = $1
                AND lease_until > clock_timestamp()
            RETURNING
                batches,
                link_rows_scanned,
                message_rows_scanned,
                rows_repaired
